Key Responsibilities: 

A. Lead generation & prospecting:
1. Identify and prospect insurance brokers, corporate agents, IMFs, POSP networks, and aggregators.
2. Build a qualified sales pipeline through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, networking, and industry events.
3. Maintain and update lead tracking in CRM.

B. Client engagement & product demonstration:
1. Conduct professional demos of BrokerZen showcasing key modules (Policy servicing, claims, renewals, reconciliation, POSP, billing, EB, etc.).
2. Understand customer needs and map them to product capabilities.
3. Present business value, ROI, and automation benefits for brokers.

C. Sales closure & negotiation:
1. Own end-to-end sales cycle- proposal creation, negotiations, pricing discussion, and contract finalization.
2. Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
3. Coordinate between product, tech, and leadership teams for smooth onboarding.

D. Relationship management:
1. Build long-term trusted relationships with broker partners and key decision makers.
2. Gather product feedback to help improve BrokerZen roadmap.
3. Ensure customer satisfaction and account retention.

E. Documentation & reporting:
1. Maintain accurate sales data, call logs, proposals, and follow-ups.
2. Prepare weekly sales pipeline reports and forecast revenue.
3. Work closely with leadership to refine sales strategy and market positioning.

4f23f8c926ad5e8f.description: Ameriprise Financial is hiring a Financial Analyst Intern in Thiruvananthapuram. This is a hands-on, mentor-led BFSI internship built for students and 2026 freshers who want real exposure to how a asset management actually runs its numbers not a certificate-only programme. About the role As a Financial Analyst Intern at Ameriprise Financial, your core focus will be variance analysis, MIS reporting and business performance tracking. You will be attached to a named mentor, join the team's daily stand-ups and reviews, and be trusted with work that genuinely matters rather than filing and formatting. Questions are encouraged, mistakes are treated as teaching moments, and your output is reviewed properly so you actually improve. What you'll do day to day Support variance analysis, MIS reporting and business performance tracking alongside the core asset management team Work in Excel and the company's internal systems on live financial data Prepare schedules, reconciliations and reports that go to real reviewers Research companies, customers, products or regulations as the work demands Turn your analysis into clear notes and decks for senior stakeholders Follow the documentation and control standards a regulated business requires Take part in reviews, ask questions and act on the feedback you receive Skills you'll build You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Financial Analysis, Advanced Excel, MIS Reporting, Variance Analysis, SQL Basics, Power BI / Tableau, Forecasting, Business Partnering, Presentation Skills, Problem Solving the exact toolkit that separates a hireable finance fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, numerical comfort and care with detail matter far more here than a polished rsum, and every one of these skills is taught on the job. Who should apply Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.Com/BBA/MBA (Finance)/B.Tech with a finance interest based in or willing to work from Thiruvananthapuram. You should be comfortable with numbers, willing to learn Financial Analysis, Advanced Excel, MIS Reporting, and able to communicate clearly in writing. Relevant coursework, certifications (NISM, CFA L1, GST, Tally) or a strong academic record in Financial Analysis will strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory. Internship details This is a 3-month internship in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, with a stipend of 39,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with an automated MIS dashboard the team keeps using. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion. You will finish this internship able to read a set of financial statements with confidence, work comfortably in Excel at speed, and explain exactly how your work fed a real business decision. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role. How to apply Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Ameriprise Financial's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats for this Financial Analysis-focused internship are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Support variance analysis, MIS reporting and business performance tracking alongside the core asset management team; Work in Excel and internal systems on live financial data; Prepare schedules, reconciliations and reports for senior review; Research companies, customers, products or regulations as required; Present analysis clearly in notes and decks for stakeholders; Follow documentation and control standards required in a regulated business. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.Com/BBA/MBA (Finance)/B.Tech with a finance interest 2026 freshers & final-year students welcome; Working knowledge of Financial Analysis, Advanced Excel, MIS Reporting (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Strong numerical ability and comfort working in MS Excel; Care with detail and the discipline to document work properly; Clear written and verbal communication in English; Based in or willing to work from Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. .
